e.title: Two-Factor Vasicek (Python)
e.summary: 双因子 Vasicek 利率模型 Python 实现（OSM/Richman）：更灵活的利率期限结构建模
e.body:
Two-Factor Vasicek 是 Ronald Richman（OSM）的 Python 实现：双因子 Vasicek 利率模型——两个均值回归因子叠加，比单因子更灵活地捕捉利率期限结构的水平与曲率变动。与 [[vasicek-one-factor-python]]（单因子）形成系列。关联 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 曲线）、[[smith-wilson-python]]（RFR 外推）、[[esg]]/[[pyesg]]（情景生成）、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[financemodels-jl]]。

## 同类工具
[[v-star-actuarial-engine]]、[[va-heatmap-simulation-machine]]、[[vinereg]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Python implementation of the two-factor Vasicek interest-rate model (OSM/Richman): more flexible term-structure modelling
e.summary_hk: 雙因子 Vasicek 利率模型 Python 實現（OSM/Richman）：更靈活的利率期限結構建模
e.body_en:
Two-Factor Vasicek is Ronald Richman's (OSM) Python implementation of the two-factor Vasicek interest-rate model — two mean-reverting factors stacked, capturing level and curvature moves of the yield curve more flexibly than the one-factor version. Forms a series with [[vasicek-one-factor-python]] (one-factor). Related: [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (NSS curves), [[smith-wilson-python]] (RFR extrapolation), [[esg]]/[[pyesg]] (scenario generation), [[actuarial-pricing]], [[financemodels-jl]].

## Similar tools
[[v-star-actuarial-engine]]、[[va-heatmap-simulation-machine]]、[[vinereg]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
